candidates.name: Storming of Bolton
candidates.description: 1644 event in the First English Civil War
candidates.extract: The Storming of Bolton, sometimes referred to as the "Bolton massacre", was an event in the First English Civil War which happened on 28 May 1644. The strongly Parliamentarian town was stormed and captured by Royalist forces under Prince Rupert.
